lede: The gondola's future takes center stage Monday when the Gondola Leadership Committee meets to work through project history, CIG funding commitments, and what sounds like real action items — this is the longest-running civic question in the valley and worth paying attention to. Wednesday, Parks and Rec revisits the controversial Town Park paving plan to install basketball and pickleball courts on the grass oval, with more than 400 signatures of opposition already on the table. The San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo kicks off Friday, and the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet is also in town to close out the week.
